shots.excerpt: Camera inside a black taxi's back seat, looking out its open rear door: she steps out in the foreground as Thug A slaps the driver beyond her.
highlight: inside a black taxi's back seat
looking out its open rear door
shots.voice: Shot 1. The camera hides inside the taxi, so the open door frames the slap like a window.

shots.excerpt: Medium-wide side view, slow lateral tracking: she steps between them, slips his right punch, traps his arm and throws him onto the pavement.
shots.voice: Shot 2. A side view with slow tracking keeps the whole interception readable in one move.

shots.excerpt: Wide, low lateral angle near ground level: she ducks, drives a knee and a side kick into Thug B, then elbows Thug C.
shots.voice: Shot 3. Keeping the camera near the ground makes every kick feel bigger and heavier.

shots.excerpt: She whips into a spinning back kick; her long black rose-embroidered coat fans out wide like a cape, a brief slow-motion beat at contact.
highlight: fans out wide like a cape
shots.voice: Shot 4. One short slow-motion beat at contact, and the rose coat turns into a cape.

shots.label: The ending
shots.excerpt: Locked wide frame: she stands facing the camera, coat settling, a small sideways glance; the driver safe by the white taxi, three thugs on the pavement.
shots.voice: The ending. No victory pose, just a still frame and a glance. That restraint is what makes it cool.
